title: Quiver data of representations of Hecke algebras and Coxeter groups
summary: Let Gamma be a Coxeter matrix and q be a generic parameter, let Hq (Gamma) be the Iwahori-Hecke algebra. We propose a concept H-representation of type [Gamma;q], which are representations of certain quiver satisfying several sets of relations. We show type [Gamma;q] H-representation and Hq (Gamma)-representation almost determine each other. By using this we construct all nonintersecting type Hq (Gamma)-representations .
